Method of Attack: Proxy botnet enabling cybercriminals to run malicious traffic anonymously through compromised devices
Malicious software developed and deployed to hack thousands of Internet-connected devices
Used InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) peer-to-peer network to hide malicious activities and resist takedown
SSH brute-forcing for spreading to adjacent systems
Impacted Systems: Internet-connected devices worldwide including Puerto Rico
Date of Discovery: June 2019 through December 2022 (active development and deployment period)
